facts.fact: The Federal Negarit Gazette 32nd Year No. 41 carries Critical Infrastructure Cyber Security Protection Proclamation No. 1426/2026, done at Addis Ababa on 21 July 2026 and signed by the President, and its article 28 provides that it enters into force one year after publication, so it is passed and not yet in force (commencement July 2027).

systems.country_label: Critical Infrastructure Cyber Security Protection Proclamation
systems.owner: Federal Democratic Republic of Ethiopia; INSA issues directives under it

note: No use of the law is stated; it has not yet commenced.
